project_name: S.D. Public School Next-Gen Website & Admin Panel
archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) blended with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) for legacy/trust, and Archetype 4 (Swiss/Authority) for Admin

rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-medium text-[#0A0F24]
rules.h1_legacy: font-legacy_brand text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl text-primary leading-none
rules.overline: uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-xs sm:text-sm text-secondary font-bold

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (p-12 to p-24). Avoid center-aligning everything; embrace asymmetry. Use Optical Alignment.
layout_spacing.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 (Mode A: The Tetris Grid)
layout_spacing.admin_grid: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 dense-packing (Mode B: Control Room Grid)

surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-black/5 saturate-150)
surface_styles.news_card: Tracing Beam variant (animated subtle border glow on hover) with sharp 1px borders
surface_styles.preschool_card: Neumorphic soft lift with solid rounded corners (rounded-3xl) and colorful borders
surface_styles.admin_card: Grid Borders (flat, 1px subtle border border-slate-200, no shadow unless hovered)

buttons.primary: bg-[#0E3B91] text-white hover:bg-blue-900 rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all active:scale-95 shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F87D0E] text-white hover:bg-orange-600 rounded-full px-8 py-3 transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.gold_premium: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#C7A15B] to-[#E2C792] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl
buttons.glass: backdrop-blur-md bg-white/20 border border-white/40 text-[#0A0F24] hover:bg-white/40 rounded-full px-6 py-2

components.navigation: Floating glass pill at the top containing main links. Quick access bar (ERP, Fee, Admission) sitting above the main nav.
components.galleries: Bento-style dynamic aspect ratios (col-span-4 vs col-span-8). Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered enter-animations. Server-side image compression logic to be built in backend.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='fee-payment-btn', data-testid='admin-login-submit').

public_website.name: Hero Video & Welcome Popup
public_website.design: Asymmetric overlay. 60% left column for text (Cormorant Garamond H1), 40% right for media/abstract gradient. Use `media.hero_abstract_gradient`. Do NOT use a heavy black overlay; keep it light and airy. Incorporate admin-controlled welcome pop-up on mount.

public_website.name: Stats Counter
public_website.design: Generous spacing. Large typography (text-6xl+) for '30+', '75+', '50000+', '5000+'. Use brand primary color.

public_website.name: Pre-School Section
public_website.design: Playful area. Background: `media.preschool_playful_bg`. Font: Fredoka. Use framer-motion for bouncy entrance animations (type: 'spring', bounce: 0.5). High saturation button accents (Pink Lotus).

public_website.name: Academic Calendar & News
public_website.design: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode). News cards with hover Tracing Beam effect. Admin-uploaded excel calendar rendered beautifully via Shadcn table/list components.

public_website.name: Student Council & Alumni
public_website.design: Neumorphic profile cards. Gold accents (#C7A15B) for Captain/Leadership roles. Alumni page includes payment integrated membership form and a hidden/unhidden registry (admin synced).

public_website.name: Admissions, Career, TC
public_website.design: Clean, multi-step Shadcn forms. Clear input borders (border-primary/20 focus:border-primary). TC Download needs Name+DOB+Admission No. validation.

admin_panel.name: Dashboard Shell
admin_panel.design: Archetype 4 (Swiss/Authority). Sidebar navigation with very dark Royal Blue (#082052) background, white text. Main content area off-white (#F8FAFC). Minimalist aesthetic.

admin_panel.name: Modules
admin_panel.design: Dense DataTables (Shadcn) for Admissions, TC uploads, News, Calendar Excel upload, and dynamic form builder for Admission Questions. Reset password via email service logic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install necessary dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, lucide-react, react-fast-marquee.
Configure tailwind.config.js with the custom colors (primary, secondary, gold, pink_lotus) and custom fonts (Outfit, Cormorant Garamond, DM Sans, Fredoka).
Build the public routes strictly following the Light Theme + Gradients visual style.
Build the /admin routes utilizing Shadcn components heavily for grids, forms, and tables (Control Room Layout).
Implement the 'playful' effects on the pre-school section using framer-motion.
Use the provided media URLs from the media object. DO NOT USE PLACEHOLDER TEXT for images.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and links have 'data-testid' attributes.
Integrate Shadcn primitives correctly, stripping away standard Vercel looks for the public marketing pages, but utilizing them efficiently in the admin dashboard.
